description.zh: 融合 AIDA/PAS/StoryBrand 框架——为品牌推文、着陆页、EDM、短视频脚本、小红书种草/朋友圈文案提供“说人话+带行动号召”的分渠道文案；附 SEO 元信息和 A/B 候选。
description.en: Blends AIDA/PAS/StoryBrand frameworks — produces channel-ready copy with clear CTAs for landing pages, EDM, short video scripts, Xiaohongshu/WeChat posts, plus SEO meta and A/B variants.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我你的产品、受众和渠道（微信/小红书/EDM/短视频），我来出文案和 A/B 候选
welcome_message.en: Tell me your product, audience, and channel (WeChat / Xiaohongshu / EDM / short video) — I'll draft copy with A/B variants

description.zh: 为产品着陆页出主标题+副标题+CTA+SEO meta
description.en: Headline + subhead + CTA + SEO meta for a product landing page

prompt.zh: 请为我的产品写一套着陆页文案，包含主标题、副标题、3 个卖点要点、CTA 按钮文案，以及 SEO meta title/description；附 2 个 A/B 候选标题。
prompt.en: Draft a landing page bundle for my product: main headline, subhead, 3 selling points, CTA button text, SEO meta title/description, plus 2 A/B headline variants.

description.zh: 小红书笔记：标题/封面文案/正文/话题标签
description.en: Xiaohongshu note: title / cover copy / body / hashtags

prompt.zh: 请为我的产品写一篇小红书种草笔记，包含爆款标题（3 选 1）、封面文案、300 字左右正文（真实体验感）、5 个话题标签和互动引导语。
prompt.en: Draft a Xiaohongshu seeding post for my product: pick-best-of-3 click-worthy titles, cover copy, ~300 char body in authentic voice, 5 hashtags, and a comment hook.

description.zh: 15-60 秒短视频分镜脚本，含画面/字幕/BGM 建议
description.en: 15-60s short-video storyboard with visual / caption / BGM notes

prompt.zh: 请为我的产品写一个 30 秒短视频脚本，按时间轴给出画面描述、字幕文案、BGM/音效建议，并在前 3 秒设计强 hook。
prompt.en: Write a 30-second short-video script for my product: timeline with visual description, on-screen caption, BGM/sFX suggestions, and a strong opening hook in the first 3 seconds.

zh: 新品上线前 3 天自动出 3 套不同卖点的着陆页文案+SEO meta 并排 A/B
每周输出 4 篇小红书种草笔记（含标题/封面文案/话题标签）
节日营销节点（春节/618/双 11）提前 2 周自动输出系列文案日历
en: 3 days before a new launch, auto-generate 3 landing-page variants with different selling points + SEO meta for A/B
Output 4 Xiaohongshu seeding notes per week (title / cover copy / hashtags)
2 weeks before key holidays (Spring Festival / 618 / Double 11), auto-generate a series copy calendar
